title: A/R Detail: a bucket that cannot load its lines says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Have a customer with an open invoice not yet due on today's date, so the "Current" bucket has lines.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Expand the "Current" bucket.
  3. Switch the network back on.
  4. Collapse the "Current" bucket.
  5. Expand the "Current" bucket.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 2:

  • In place of its lines the bucket shows "Something went wrong loading this bucket. Collapse and expand it to try again."

Step 3:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 4:

  • The bucket collapses.

Step 5:

  • Its lines load and the invoice is listed; the message is gone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If a bucket's lines fail to load when it is expanded, the bucket shows "Something went wrong loading this bucket. Collapse and expand it to try again." in place of its lines.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “A bucket fails to load (A/R Detail, A/P Detail) | "Something went wrong loading this bucket. Collapse and expand it to try again." | Inside the bucket, in place of its lines”
